notes: CDER nonsterile OTC-manufacturer CGMP letter: lack of process and cleaning validation (shared equipment with cosmetics), no stability studies for wound-treatment products intended for children, and an inadequately designed/tested non-sterile water system (Burkholderia cepacia complex named only as a required test organism, not confirmed contamination, matching the world-perfumes precedent for this same boilerplate water-system language). Also charges 'Carpe ANTIPERSPIRANT FOOT LOTION', 'Carpe ANTIPERSPIRANT HAND LOTION', and a redacted '(b)(4)' skin-protectant product as unapproved new drugs (non-conforming to OTC monographs M016/M019) and misbranded under 502(ee); since other products are named in clear, product_redacted is false. location_contains is 'Marietta' alone because the inspection sentence omits the state ('at 1633 Sands Pl SE. Marietta, from October 15th to 25th 2024'). recall_concern is true because the letter requests actions such as 'customer notifications and product recalls' in response to the water-system risk assessment.
